thread:
anna_pm: Quick sync — KeyLoom wants to pilot cross-cloud KMS + SSO for our marketplace listing. Can we map out ops + launch timeline?

james_sales: Awesome. They asked for a co-announcement mid-July. Is that still realistic? :calendar:

mira_eng: Mid-July is tight. Need 2 weeks for KMS BYOK tests across AWS/GCP, plus SAML end-to-end verification.

oliver_security: Also need HSM attestation paperwork and an updated threat model for private deployments. Legal will want that before any press.

partner_ops: From KeyLoom side: can delay press 1 week if needed, but they'd like marketplace tile live same day as announcement.

anna_pm: Ok — proposed plan: (1) KMS BYOK test window: 7 days (2) SAML/SCIM smoke tests: 3 days (3) HSM compliance docs: parallel 5 days. Can we compress?

mira_eng: We can parallelize SAML work with KMS testing. But the HSM vendor certificate rotation scenario needs a small infra change — estimate 2 dev days.

oliver_security: I'll own the risk doc. Need KeyLoom to supply their FIPS cert and PKCS#11 compatibility note by EOD Tues.

james_sales: I'll nudge them today. Also confirm HQ press embargo window — they prefer 48h embargo.

partner_ops: Noted. KeyLoom will share certs by Tue AM. Embargo ok. Please publish a staging marketplace tile so partners can preview.

mira_eng: For SCIM mapping, simplest is to re-use our org schema with attrs: externalId -> id, emails -> primaryEmail, groups -> groupNames. Example mapping below: 
```json
{
  "externalId": "user.external_id",
  "emails": "user.email",
  "groups": "user.groups[]"
}
```
Use that for the smoke harness.

anna_pm: Great. Who's doing the staging tile? Product/marketing?

james_sales: Marketing owns marketing copy, I'll pair with product to push tile to staging. Ops — need a service account with marketplace-scoped role.

devops_bot: Created ticket INF-8241: "marketplace/staging/tile-keyloom" assigned to eng-ops. ETA 2d.

mira_eng: Also: routing policy — when customer selects KeyLoom KMS, route through dedicated crypto pool in us-west1 for latency. Can we get policy rule in config? 

partner_ops: KeyLoom asked for a fallback plan if HSM handshake fails — prefer actionable error that suggests "use hosted KMS" option.

oliver_security: Agreed. Add an automated fallback that logs incident tag #keyloom-kms-fallback and notifies oncall for 5xx errors.

anna_pm: Summary / owners: KMS certs by KeyLoom (partner_ops); infra routing + fallback (mira_eng + devops); HSM attestation + risk doc (oliver_security); marketplace tile + copy (james_sales + marketing). Target: soft-launch to staging 2026-07-01, announce 2026-07-08 (48h embargo).

james_sales: I'll confirm dates with KeyLoom and legal.

partner_ops: Confirmed on our side, will push certs Tue and join smoke tests Wed.

anna_pm: Perfect. If blockers pop up ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
